sql_query:
SELECT
  (date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp))::date AS month_start,
  ABS(SUM(op.payment_value)) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments op
  ON o.order_id = op.order_id
WHERE
  o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND op.payment_value IS NOT NULL
  AND date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) >= date_trunc('month', current_date) - INTERVAL '11 months'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < date_trunc('month', current_date) + INTERVAL '1 month'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
